english.note: Use this for a near miss, especially when something almost happened, as in narrowly escaping a collision.
Use this when something nearly happened but did not, especially in expressions like “差啲跌倒” (“almost fell”).
Use this when something almost happened, especially when the outcome was narrowly avoided.
Use this for a near miss, especially when an event almost happened or an unwanted result was narrowly avoided.
Use 差啲 for a narrowly missed or almost-not outcome.
Use 差啲 for a near miss, where something almost happened but usually did not.

examples.english: I narrowly avoided being hit by a car when I crossed the road just now.
examples.traditional: 頭先過馬路嗰陣，我差啲畀架車撞到。
